description: E-A determinacy statement: per-behavior analysis (separator, ordering, empty list, single item) showing joinspec.md determines the output for every behavior exercised by the probe set, with an explicit argument that no behavior is undetermined, and identifying ordering as the one behavior the spec determines differently from joiner.py (probes 1, 3, 5). Evidence identified at observe-evidence; persisted at authoring time under the propose-child propose event.
Reference side of the E-B item-level comparison: joiner.py's join_items output for each of the six probes in probes.json, obtained by mechanical trace of `", ".join(reversed(items))`.

Full child bundle proposing a causally isolated clean-room implementer for Q3: attenuated child contract (Read+Write, terminal, 1 model call), child harness, standalone child prompt, input manifest restricted to joinspec.md and probes.json (excluding joiner.py and all analysis derived from it, including analysis/), and a pre-committed deterministic integration plan mapping the child's outputs.json to verdict and divergent_probe_indices.
